uneven1080.derived: в компоненте: при масштабе между k и k+1 исходных пикселей шириной k ровно (k+1)·n − m; для 1080p это совпадает с замером

flags.default: resizable window opening at the largest whole multiple of 2× or more within 85% of the visible screen, else the fraction that fits (down to half); its size is kept across Alt+Enter
flags.original: `--original-window`, or `defaults write local.ntsd.native NTSDOriginalWindow -bool YES` (a bare executable: `-NTSDOriginalWindow YES`)
flags.fullScreen: the green button or View ▸ Enter Full Screen (⌃⌘F)

flags.host: SDL (Linux, macOS SDL; Windows shares the code, not built)
flags.default: resizable, maximisable, high pixel density, the same initial size rule
flags.fullScreen: the window manager's maximise and full-screen controls (macOS SDL: the green button, a zoom, not tried by hand); no game key is taken, since the original receives F1–F12

flags.original: the launch argument `--original-window` or the NTSDOriginalWindow default

flags.default: the whole screen, aspect kept (the compositor scales)
flags.original: `--original-window` in the app's `files/args.txt` (one argument per line; needs adb `run-as`): one device pixel per pixel, centred

flags.default: the canvas fitted to the page
flags.original: `?original-window` (alias `?original`; `=0`, `=false`, `=no` turn it off; the real name wins over the alias), or `"originalWindow": true` in config.json; `web_run.mjs --original-window`
flags.fullScreen: the page's Full screen button; the browser's own full screen (F11, the green button) enlarges the page, which the default fit follows, while the original window stays 1:1 there
